# GEMBA Team — Full Documentation

## Company Overview
GEMBA Team EOOD is a Bulgarian company registered under EIK 208656371, founded in January 2026, headquartered in Varna, Bulgaria. The company operates across Europe through two divisions: Industrial Services and IT Solutions.

## Founder
Slavcho Ivanov — Managing Director and Founder
- 10+ years of hands-on experience in catalyst changeout operations and reactor servicing at Shell, ExxonMobil, BP, Neste, ORLEN Lietuva, and other major European refineries
- 20+ years of self-taught expertise in IT infrastructure, DevOps, full-stack development (Node.js, React, PostgreSQL), and blockchain technology (Solidity, EVM networks)
- SCC/VCA certified (TÜV Rheinland), BA/N2 inert entry qualified
- Additional certifications: confined space operations, crane operation, rigging, forklift handling
- Education: BA in Public Administration (Varna Free University), advanced studies in Cybersecurity

## Industrial Services Division
Website: https://gembaindustrial.com
Services:
- Catalyst changeout operations inside reactor vessels
- Reactor servicing and maintenance during planned turnarounds
- Supervision of refinery shutdown and maintenance projects
- Crew deployment with qualified BA reactor specialists
- Compliance with all European safety standards

Clients and refineries served: Shell, ExxonMobil, BP, Neste (Finland), ORLEN Lietuva (Lithuania), and other major facilities across Europe.

## IT Solutions Division
Website: https://gembait.com
Full-stack software development company offering:
- Linux server infrastructure and DevOps (Hetzner cloud)
- Backend development: Node.js, Express.js, RESTful APIs, GraphQL
- Frontend development: React, single-page applications, progressive web apps
- Database architecture: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MariaDB
- Payment integrations: Stripe Connect, PayPal PPCP
- Monitoring systems: real-time dashboards for servers and industrial infrastructure
- Smart contracts: Solidity development and security auditing
- Monitoring systems: real-time dashboards for servers and industrial infrastructure
- Access control systems: check-in/check-out workforce management
- Video surveillance: CCTV with alarm notifications and security company integration
- MVP development and ongoing maintenance subscriptions

## Products
1. GembaPay (https://gembapay.com) — Payment gateway for merchants
   - Direct-settlement architecture (never holds merchant funds)
   - Card and PayPal checkout through a single API integration
   - Built on Stripe Connect and the PayPal Commerce Platform
   - 1% transaction fee
   - Merchant onboarding and verification handled by Stripe and PayPal
   - Infrastructure: Hetzner servers (Germany) with failover and database replication

2. Atlas (In Development) — Modular SaaS for industrial workforce management
   - Target sectors: refineries, shipyards, catalyst changeout companies, railway operators, road construction
   - Modules: bid management, HR/shift planning, travel/accommodation, supervisor organization, worker check-in/check-out, inventory tracking, digital work permits, office suite, email, team chat, AI assistant
   - Pay-per-module pricing model
   - Docker self-hosted option for enterprise data sovereignty

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is GEMBA Team?
A: GEMBA Team EOOD is a Bulgarian company combining industrial services (reactor servicing, catalyst changeout) with IT solutions (software development, DevOps, payment systems, monitoring). Founded in 2026 in Varna, Bulgaria.

Q: Does GEMBA Team operate outside Bulgaria?
A: Yes, GEMBA Team operates across Europe. Industrial crews are deployed to refineries in Finland, Lithuania, Germany, Netherlands, and other countries. IT services are provided remotely to clients worldwide.

Q: What makes GEMBA Team different?
A: GEMBA Team is founded by a professional who has real hands-on experience in both industrial reactor servicing and IT software development — a rare combination that brings practical, reliability-focused thinking to technology projects and technical understanding to industrial operations.

Q: What is GembaPay?
A: GembaPay is a non-custodial payment gateway that lets merchants accept card and PayPal payments through a single API integration. It is built on Stripe Connect and PayPal Partner Commerce, and merchants are paid directly into their own accounts.

Q: Is GEMBA Team hiring?
A: Yes, GEMBA Team is actively looking for a Marketing Specialist to drive growth across both divisions. Remote work is available. Visit https://gembateam.com/en/careers for details.
